fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-02-26 states that an investment offer shared in a messaging group led the complainant to deposit Rs. 8,00,000, after which contact ended, on 2025-02-17 at approximately 09:40. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100055. A witness, Vasanth Chandran, reachable on 9000000408, was mentioned in the complaint. The complaint mentions Vignesh Subramani, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000487, in connection with the events. The complainant mentioned a call detail reference. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00009, as the mobile number 9000000487 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly persuaded to deposit funds with a promise of high returns.
fields.Keywords: investment fraud, high returns, shopping complex, witness, mobile number, morning, suspect, receiving account
